subject.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens

question: Should the automatic offer response be invalidated whenever the originating inline browser or dashboard closes before the status query completes?
rationale: The supplied current-head review identifies a concrete lifecycle race, while the protected label requires explicit macOS owner handling.

options.title: Invalidate closed-browser requests
options.body: Keep the PR open until close-before-response results are ignored and covered by a focused regression.

options.title: Accept delayed banner display
options.body: Proceed only if the macOS owner explicitly intends the offer to appear on a later dashboard opening after the browser was closed.

recommendation.title: Invalidate closed-browser requests
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open until close-before-response results are ignored and covered by a focused regression.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and are actively refining this macOS banner lifecycle.
